text_block_list.text: Admire Vega and I gather the courage to tell Meisho Doto the hard facts. Without the ambition to defeat T.M. Opera O, her future is bleak.
That also goes for T.M. Opera O. If the two don't grow by competing against each other, they'll stand no chance against the previous generation.
And it seems our words reach Meisho Doto. Once again, her unyielding fighting spirit propels her forward on her journey.
With that, Meisho Doto decides to announce her rivalry with T.M. Opera O at the Japan Cup, for both of their sakes.
